_comment: 生成物，别手改。scripts/export-codex.ts 从 data/vanilla/units 与 vanilla-assets.json 生成。

desc.zh: 将沉重炮身深扎于地，以寸步不移为代价全力轰击敌阵。
desc.en: They plant their heavy cannon firmly in the earth and unleash its full fury upon the enemy ranks, yielding not a step.

desc.zh: 短兵相接激起潜藏的妖鬼蛮力，战意愈烈，筋骨愈韧。
desc.en: The clash of close combat rouses the savage might within; as their battle-fury rises, flesh and bone grow ever more resilient.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以对所有敌军部队引发恐惧，令附近敌军遭受领导力惩罚。同时这支部队自身也对恐惧效果免疫。恐惧惩罚不能叠加
desc.en: This unit frightens all enemy units, reducing their leadership when nearby. It is also immune to fear. Fear penalties do not stack.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以隐蔽在森林里，除非敌人走到近前，否则他们不会被发现
desc.en: This unit can hide in forests until enemy units get too close.
